title: document.classified
description: The pipeline classified a parsed document: its type, whether it is a regulatory document, how sure the classifier is of the type and why. A conflict (the text names another type than its source publishes) opens a triage task, and the person's decision is classified again, certain. An irrelevant document is set aside and a conflict waits for its triage; a press release or a statute is kept for reference; a notification, circular or act amendment goes on to the rule extraction. Producer: pipeline (the ingest's classify step and a triage's resolution). Consumers: none yet.
x-producer: pipeline (the ingest's classify step and a triage's resolution)

source_key.description: The source's key, such as cbic_notifications.

doc_type.description: Document type: what its opening names, its source's when it names none, or what a person gave (an uploader, a triage). For a conflict, the type the text names.

relevance.description: Whether it is a regulatory document; irrelevant for one such as a portal user manual listed among notifications, which is set aside.

confidence.description: How sure the type is: certain when the text names the type its source publishes or a person gave it, default when the text names none and the source's is taken, conflict when the text names another type, which a person triages.

reasons.description: Why, in words: the type's reason first, then the relevance's.

classifier.description: What classified it: the rule-based detector with its version (detector@1), or triage for a person's decision.

task_id.description: The triage task a conflict opened, or the one whose resolution decided it; null otherwise.

decided_by.description: The analyst whose triage decided it; null when the detector did, or a service resolved the task.
